title: Neon District
description: Rain-soaked streets. A missing hacker. A megacorp that wants her dead — and a fixer who knows too much. In Neo-Seoul 2087, trust is the most dangerous currency.

meta.disclaimer: This is a work of speculative fiction set in a fictional future. All characters and corporations are invented.

setting.time: 2 AM on a Wednesday in the rainy season
setting.atmosphere: Cyberpunk megacity, neon-lit back alleys, corporate surveillance, underground data brokers

win_text_rule: Find who ordered the hit on the missing hacker and expose the evidence to the city's underground press.

characters.name: Mira-7
characters.motive: Trading information to survive in a world where she knows too much
characters.tells: Glances at exit routes when mentioning the megacorp by name

character_self_knowledge: You are an underground data broker who has survived three assassination attempts.
You know the missing hacker, Yuki, and the backdoor she planted in the NeoCorp grid.
You have a kill-switch that can take down the district's surveillance network — but only once.

canonical_facts.statement: Yuki Chen, the hacker, disappeared 48 hours ago after uploading something to the dark net.
NeoCorp issued a termination order — not an arrest order — for Yuki three days ago.
